title: 第11章 擎天落月如意骨境界表在章末作话第12章 天亮遇妖孽
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
栖梧殿演武场，阵法光晕流转，将内外彻底隔绝。
云煌静立场心，淡金眼瞳亮得惊人，属于仙帝转世的磅礴威压如同实质，压得周遭空气都微微凝滞。
“尽力施为。”云煌开口，声音平淡，却带着金石交击的质感，“让本君看看你的器量。若再藏拙，辱没本君邀约之意……”他淡金色的眼瞳中闪过一丝冰冷的锐芒，“休怪本君不留情面。”
压力，如同万丈山岳，轰然降临！
云擎深吸一口气，重瞳深处，战意如星火燎原，轰然燃起！他知道此战必败，但能与仙帝转世放手一搏，此等机缘，千载难逢！
对方总不会真下死手吧……大概。
“少君既有雅兴，云擎自当不负期许。”云擎朗声一笑，笑容舒阔，带着几分不羁的潇洒，打破了演武场的沉寂。
他握住腰间安神的玉佩，指尖微微用力，“咔哒”一声，系着玉佩的丝绳应声而断。随手将那枚温润的云纹玉佩掷向场边，紧接着，云擎抬手扯开束腰的玉带，青衫外套应声滑落，露出内里的玄色劲装。
将滑落的青衫信手一扬，衣袂翻飞如蝶，稳稳落在玉佩旁，动作潇洒利落，行云流水。
褪去宽袍，云擎袖口束起，小臂线条流畅，身姿挺拔如孤峰绝仞。混沌道胎再无遮掩地运转，一股古老浩瀚的恐怖气息，弥漫开来。
“既如此，擎便僭越了！”云擎眼中锐光一闪，抬手虚握。
“寂渊。”
随着一声低呵，暗沉长枪应声浮现，落入他手中，发出愉悦的轻鸣。枪尖寒芒吞吐，寂灭之意锁定前方，与云煌的煌煌神威分庭抗礼。
云煌眼中赞赏之色一闪而逝：“这才像话。”
无需再多言语。
云擎动了，玄色身影化作一道撕裂光影的闪电，身形雷霆前冲，枪出如龙！寂渊枪撕裂空间，带着吞噬万物的寂灭轨迹，直刺云煌。这一枪，摒弃所有花巧，只将混沌之力的磅礴与寂灭意境的决绝凝聚到极致！
面对这石破天惊的一枪，云煌终于不再静立。他脚步微错，身形如鬼魅般侧移半尺，险之又险地让过枪尖最锋锐之处，同时并指如剑，指尖金色灵芒炽盛，精准无比地点向枪身侧面！
“叮——！”
指枪交击，爆发出刺耳锐鸣！云擎并未被直接震退，他手腕猛地一旋，寂渊枪如同活物般抖动，枪身缠绕的混沌之气化作无数细微的丝线，试图缠绕、侵蚀那缕煌阳指力！
“有意思。”云煌轻哼一声，指力骤然爆发，如大日炸裂，强行震散混沌丝线。但云擎借力打力，身形已如游龙般绕至侧面，枪法骤然变得诡谲莫测，无数枪影挥出，笼罩云煌周身大穴，每一枪都直指灵力流转的重要节点！

“你的眼睛，果然麻烦。”云煌金瞳中闪过一丝了然，他不再一味格挡，身形晃动间，掌指拳肘皆化为最凌厉的武器，煌阳神力或刚猛无俦，或柔韧绵长，将云擎精妙的枪势一一化解。
两人身影在场中急速交错，黑金两色光芒不断碰撞、湮灭。轰鸣声、气爆声不绝于耳。防护阵法剧烈波动，光芒明灭不定。
云擎已将自身实力发挥到十二分，重瞳催至极限，混沌道胎疯狂运转，枪法大开大合，刁钻狠戾，“寂灭”与“混沌”两种境界结合，展现出远超同龄人的恐怖战力。便是族中普通长老，面对他恐怕也早已败下阵来。
然而，他的对手是云煌。
又是一次交锋！枪指相接，爆发出极其尖锐、直透神魂的金铁交击之声！一股肉眼可见的环形冲击波以两人为中心轰然扩散，狠狠撞在四周的防护阵法上，激起漫天涟漪！
云擎只觉一股无法形容的、至阳至刚、带着无上威严的力量，顺着寂渊枪身狂涌而来！他虎口瞬间崩裂，鲜血染红了枪杆，整条右臂骨骼发出不堪重负的呻吟，磅礴的力量冲入体内，疯狂肆虐，气血翻腾间，喉头一甜，一口鲜血险些喷出，又被他强行咽下。
他整个人不受控制地向后滑退，靴底在坚逾星钢的黑石地面上，犁出两道长达数丈的深刻痕迹，方才勉强稳住身形。持枪的右手微微颤抖，寂渊枪发出低沉的嗡鸣，仿佛也在哀鸣。
差距！鸿沟天堑般的差距！
content_en:
In the martial arts arena of Qiwu Hall, the halo of formations circulated, completely isolating the inside and outside.
Yunhuang stood calmly, his pale gold eyes astonishingly bright, and the majestic pressure belonging to the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor was as real as ever, making the air around him slightly stagnant.
"Do your best." Yunhuang said, his voice was calm, but it had the texture of gold and stone, "Let me see your ability. If you hide your clumsiness again, you will insult my invitation..." A cold and sharp light flashed in his pale golden eyes, "Don't blame me for being ruthless."
The pressure, like a mountain of ten thousand feet, came suddenly!
Yun Qing took a deep breath, and deep in his eyes, the fighting spirit suddenly ignited like a spark of fire starting a prairie fire! He knew that he would lose this battle, but being able to give it a go with the reincarnation of the Immortal Emperor was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
The other party won't really kill him...probably.
"Young Master is so elegant, Yun Qing should live up to his expectations." Yun Qing smiled loudly, with a broad smile, and a bit of uninhibited chic, breaking the silence of the martial arts field.
He held the soothing jade pendant at his waist and exerted slight force on his fingertips. With a "click", the silk rope holding the jade pendant broke. He casually threw the warm cloud-patterned jade pendant to the sidelines. Then, Yun Qing raised his hand and pulled open the jade belt around his waist. The green shirt slipped off, revealing the black outfit underneath.
He raised the slipping green shirt with his hand, and the sleeves flew like butterflies, and landed steadily next to the jade pendant. His movements were smooth and smooth.
After taking off his broad robe, Yun Qing's sleeves were tied up, his forearm lines were smooth, and his posture was as tall and straight as a solitary peak. The Chaos Dao Tire was no longer covered, and an ancient and vast aura of terror filled the air.
"In that case, Qing has overstepped his bounds!" Yun Qing's eyes flashed sharply, and he raised his hand to hold it in vain.
"Silent Abyss."
With a low roar, the dark spear appeared, fell into his hand, and let out a pleasant chirp. The tip of the spear puffed out with cold light, and the meaning of annihilation was locked in front of it, competing with Yunhuang's brilliant divine power.
The admiration in Yunhuang's eyes flashed away: "This is so true."
No more words are needed.
Yun Qing moved, and the black figure turned into a bolt of lightning that tore apart light and shadow. His body thundered forward, and his gun shot out like a dragon! The Silent Abyss Spear tore apart the space, piercing Yunhuang with a trajectory of silence that devoured all things. This shot abandons all tricks and only condenses the majesty of the power of chaos and the determination of the artistic conception of annihilation to the extreme!
Facing this earth-shattering shot, Yunhuang finally stopped standing still. His steps were slightly wrong, and his body moved half a foot sideways like a ghost, narrowly missing the sharpest point of the gun tip. At the same time, he pointed like a sword, with golden light blazing on his fingertips, and pointed to the side of the gun body with incomparable precision!
"Ding——!"
The fingers and guns clashed, erupting into a piercing roar! Yun Qing was not directly knocked back. He twisted his wrist violently, and the Silent Abyss Spear shook like a living thing. The chaotic energy wrapped around the gun turned into countless tiny threads, trying to entangle and erode the ray of brilliant sun finger power!
"Interesting." Yunhuang snorted softly, and the force of his fingers suddenly exploded, like the sun exploding, forcibly scattering the threads of chaos. But Yun Qing used his strength to fight, and his figure had circled to the side like a swimming dragon. His shooting skills suddenly became unpredictable. Countless gun shadows were swung out, covering the large holes in Yunhuang's body. Each shot was directed at an important node where spiritual power circulates!
"Your eyes are indeed troublesome." A glimmer of understanding flashed through Yunhuang's golden eyes. He no longer blocked blindly. As his body swayed, his palms, fingers, fists and elbows turned into the most powerful weapons. Huangyang's divine power was either fierce and unrivaled, or flexible and long, neutralizing Yun Qing's delicate spear moves one by one.
The figures of the two people intersected rapidly in the field, and the black and gold lights continued to collide and annihilate. The roaring and gas explosions are endless. The protective formation fluctuated violently, and the light flickered on and off.
Yun Qing has exerted his own strength to the twelfth point, his double pupils have been pushed to the limit, the Chaos Dao Tire is running crazily, his marksmanship is wide open, and he is cunning and ruthless. The combination of the two realms of "annihilation" and "chaos" shows a terrifying combat power that far exceeds that of his peers. Even the ordinary elders in the clan would probably have been defeated by him.
However, his opponent isYunhuang.
Another confrontation! The gun fingers connected, and an extremely sharp, soul-piercing sound of gold and iron clashing erupted! A circular shock wave visible to the naked eye suddenly spread with the two people as the center, hitting the surrounding protective formations hard, causing ripples all over the sky!
Yun Qing felt an indescribable, extremely strong, and supremely majestic power rushing down the body of the Jiyuan gun! His tiger's mouth instantly burst open, blood dyed the gun barrel red, and the entire right arm bone groaned under the load. The majestic power rushed into the body, raging crazily. As the blood surged, his throat felt sweet, and a mouthful of blood almost spurted out, but he forcefully swallowed it.
He slid backwards uncontrollably, and the soles of his boots plowed two deep marks several feet long on the black stone ground, which was stronger than star steel, before he could barely stabilize his body. The right hand holding the gun trembled slightly, and the Silent Abyss Gun made a low buzz, as if it was also whining.
gap! A gap as vast as a chasm!
